Every handoff drags full context along, burning tokens while you sleep. Fix it: trim agent memory, scope tasks tight, kill unneeded chatter. Multi-agent isn't free. Follow for more AI cost-saving tips!

Aquela delegação "inteligente"? Cada handoff arrasta o contexto inteiro junto, queimando tokens enquanto você dorme.
